storyboard_observation: Tactile industrial supplier readiness scene: a small unbranded precision-component workshop model at lower right beside a review table with three blank process/data folders converging at an unfinished handoff. The abstract model is illustrative, not a real semiconductor factory. Main visual authority is the200+ numeral in large navy/blue type, not a pile of computer chips. Clear whitespace, neutral daylight. No readable text or numbers on props, no monitor, people, customer logos, certification seal or glowing integration paths.
